name: Cabin

spine.record: Property, calendar snapshot, turnover and owner statement

description: Vacation-rental operations for US hosts and managers: Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com calendars synced both ways by iCal with overlapping requests declined, a direct-booking page with Stripe payment, signed agreement, ID check and damage hold, turnovers with door codes, cleaner email, checklists and photos, a guest inbox with scheduled messages and drafted replies, stay recovery, payout-matched owner statements with an owner portal, books posted to Pantry or exported for QuickBooks, move-in from Guesty, Hostaway or OwnerRez, and backup and restore.
nonGoals: Airbnb, Vrbo or Booking.com partner APIs (calendars sync by iCal; channel messages, prices and closing within seconds need partner accounts)
Dynamic pricing or PriceLabs and Wheelhouse connections
A live QuickBooks Online connection (QuickBooks gets CSV and IIF export files)
Text messages in the guest inbox until the owner's Twilio A2P registration

externals.why: Worker hosting for a hosted Cabin; Cabin also runs on your own computer without it.

A hosted Cabin emails sign-in links, invitations, cleaner jobs, guest messages, receipts and owner statements through the owner's own SendGrid, Resend or Cloudflare mail; Cabin on your own computer sends no email.
data: Guest, cleaner and owner message text

externals.why: Direct-booking payment, the damage-deposit hold, Stripe Identity checks and test payouts for statements, with the owner's own Stripe keys.
data: Identity verification status (no ID images are kept)

externals.why: Drafted guest replies with the owner's own Anthropic API key; without it Cabin drafts from templates.
data: Guest message text and stay details

externals.why: Texts with guests through the owner's own Twilio number after US A2P registration.
Door codes pushed to the owner's smart locks through their Seam account; without it codes are set on the keypad by hand.
Approved owner statements posted to the owner's own Pantry books with a scoped, revocable integration credential.
data: Matched booking, payout, fee and expense evidence

deploy.notes: Native owner sessions guard /app; unknown paths return real 404s; development and demo mail is suppressed.
